1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora de hasta 12 m de longitud, con tallo ramificado y provisto de un gran número de zarcillos, hojas simples, alternas, flores pequeñas en forma de campana, de color blanco con ligeras tonalidades verdosas, y fruto comestible. (Cucurbitaceae; Sechium edule).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Climbing plant of up to 12 m in length, with a branched stem and equipped with a large number of tendrils, simple alternate leaves, small bell-shaped flowers in white with light greenish tints, and edible fruit. (Cucurbitaceae; Sechium edule).
